title: Icthlarin's Little Helper
start: Talk to the wanderer, south-east of the southern bridge over the River Elid, in the desert far south of Al Kharid.

items.t: A kitten, a cat, an overgrown cat, or a hellcat (it will only need to be out for seconds at a time, so cat food is unnecessary)
Salt shaker (tool belt works), bag of salt, or an empty bucket to obtain a pile of salt

recommended.t: Weight-reducing clothing to preserve run energy
A few thousand coins to pay for magic carpets (Ring of charos (a) reduces fees)
Protection from desert heat and poison
Food in case of trap damage and being attacked
Pollnivneach Teleports, Pharaoh's sceptre, or some other method to travel to Sophanem
Ghostspeak amulet for optional dialogue with Klenter and an achievement

kills.t: Apmeken, Het, Crondis, or Scabaras apparitions (levels 56-58)
Mummies (level 70) and scarab swarms (level 12) are not required, but aggressive nonetheless.

rewards.t: Access to the city of Sophanem

steps.t: Head to the north of Sophanem. You can use the magic carpet network south of Shantay Pass from Al Kharid to get to Nardah, and then run southwest.
Talk to the wanderer while your cat is following you. [Chat: 1 Why? [Icthlarin's Little Helper] › Accept › 4 Tell me about Sophanem. [Icthlarin's Little Helper]]

sub.t: The wanderer is located a short distance north of Sophanem, east of the river but west of the Agility Pyramid.

steps.t: Open the northern door on the southern pyramid (picture of a cat).
You will arrive inside a maze.
p: Demonstrating the path to avoid the pitfalls.

steps.t: Run past the initial wall crushers and walk on the denser rubble (dotted lines indicate the locations of pitfall traps).

sub.t: Alternatively follow the path shown in the image to the right.

steps.t: Avoid traps and aggressive monsters until you reach a pit.

sub.t: [Optional] Run past the wall crushers to the east and open the chest to complete Icthlarin's Little Chest.

steps.t: Jump across the pit. This requires at least 20% run energy.
Open the doorway of the western room.
Solve the puzzle.
p: First get a puzzle like this.
Then click on the place where the red highlight is.
You get a picture like this. Click again on the red highlight.
You get a picture like this. Click again on the red highlight to complete the puzzle.
The puzzle will look like this when solved correctly.

steps.t: Talk to the Sphinx with your cat or kitten out. [Chat: 1 I need help. › 1 Okay, that sounds fair. › 2 9. › 1 Totally positive.]
Talk to the High Priest, located inside the Temple of Icthlarin in the south part of the city. You do not need your cat or kitten out for this.
Note down the name of the canopic jar in the backpack.
Go back to the southern pyramid and open the door.
Go through the pyramid again. Jump across the pit and open the west doorway.
Take the jar on the ground that has the same name as the one in the backpack previously.
Kill the apparition that spawns. You can safe-spot it by using the table in the room (unless you have the canopic jar of Apmeken or Crondis).
Take the jar again.
Open the doorway to exit the room.
Open the doorway to enter the west room again.
Return the canopic jar by clicking the empty space with the lighting effect (the original location of your jar).
Exit the pyramid. Opening the doorway should automatically take you to the entrance.
Talk to the High Priest. [Chat: 1 Sure, no problem.]
Talk to the embalmer at the spice shop, north-west of the temple.
Talk to the carpenter at the potter's wheel, just east of the southern pyramid. [Chat: 2 Alright, I'll get the wood for you.]
Talk to him again with willow logs in your inventory.
Talk to Raetul near the Sphinx to obtain linen.
p: The Sphinx you need to talk to

steps.t: Skip these steps if you already have salt:

sub.t: Bring an empty bucket just north of Sophanem to a small open lake (refer to map shown right).
Collect from the salty water for a bucket of salty water.
Search the centre piece, located just south-east of the southern pyramid. [Chat: 1 Pour your bucket of salty water into the font.]
Search the centre piece for a pile of salt. [Chat: 1 Scrape it out.]

p: The west doorway past the large pit jump

steps.t: Talk to the embalmer, located just south-west of the southern pyramid.
Talk to the carpenter for a holy symbol.

sub.t: This may take a few seconds before he finishes the symbol.

steps.t: Enter the pyramid once again and jump over the pit.
Open the doorway of the eastern room.
Search the first sarcophagus to your immediate west, on the northern wall, and hide the unholy symbol in it. [Chat: 1 Hide the unholy symbol in this sarcophagus.]

sub.t: Searching other sarcophagi is optional and not recommended.

steps.t: Open the doorway to exit the room.
Open the doorway to enter the eastern room again. Finish the dialogue with the High Priest and the wanderer.
p: The canopic jars in the burial room

steps.t: Kill the Possessed Priest.
Talk to the High Priest.
Open the doorway to exit the room to return to the temple. [Chat: 1 Yes, return to the high priest in Sophanem.]

sub.t: You may be given the canopic jar again, which has no further use and can be dropped (it will turn to dust).

p: Fighting the Possessed Priest, servant of Amascut.

steps.t: Talk to the High Priest.
Quest complete!

p: Icthlarin encounters you within the Pyramid.
